select * from t where name='a' and length(name)=1; -- without constant propagated

name: TestNestedInnerJoinPredicatePropagation
cases: SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN t3.a FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.a = t2.a JOIN t3 ON t2.a = t3.a WHERE t1.a = 1
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN t3.a FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.a = t2.a JOIN t3 ON t2.a = t3.a WHERE t1.a > 1
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN t3.a FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.a = t2.a AND t1.a = 1 JOIN t3 ON t2.a = t3.a
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN t4.a FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.a = t2.a JOIN t3 ON t2.a = t3.a JOIN t4 ON t3.a = t4.a WHERE t1.a = 1
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN t3.a FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.a = t2.a AND t1.a = 1 JOIN t3 ON t2.a = t3.a WHERE t3.a = 2
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN t3.a FROM t1 JOIN t2 USING (a) JOIN t3 USING (a) WHERE t1.a = 1
SELECT t3.a, t1.a FROM t3 LEFT JOIN (t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.a = t2.a) ON t3.a = t1.a AND t1.a = 1 ORDER BY t3.a
SELECT t1.a, t3.a FROM (t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.a = t2.a AND t1.a = 1) LEFT JOIN t3 ON t3.a = t1.a ORDER BY t1.a
SELECT t4.a FROM t4 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.a = t2.a JOIN t3 ON t2.a = t3.a WHERE t1.a = t4.a AND t1.a = 1) ORDER BY t4.a
